Recorded for visibility, not as a blocker. I reproduced the residual by reading the code rather than accepting the disposition: _legitimate_journal_bundles constrains the target SET to the Full track three or the Lite track two, but leaves the per-entry pre_hash/post_hash encoding unconstrained. A planted journal carrying a legitimate Full-track set, with pre_hash ABSENT and post_hash set to the current live digest on one entry and the current live digest as pre_hash on the others, still classifies MIX and drives _restore_to_pre into unlinking that live in-set artifact. This is squarely inside the class investigation.md Ruling (c) closed on 2026-08-29, which names attacker-driven deletion of an in-set artifact explicitly and was made with the deletion-versus-substitution difference stated to the owner. I found nothing in this area outside the ruling stated scope: a journal-supplied path containing an embedded null cannot reach os.path.realpath, because the allowlist membership test short-circuits first, and --feature is fullmatch-constrained to ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$ so no traversal enters the containment references.
